Football Club de Metz is a French association football club based in Metz, Lorraine. Founded in 1919, the club competes in the Ligue 2, following relegation from the Ligue 1 in the 2025-26 season. They play their home matches at Stade Saint-Symphorien located within the city. Despite never winning the top flight, they have won the Coupe de France twice and the Coupe de la Ligue twice.
